prioritized_defects.description: The 'Leave multicast group' action is still not semantically reachable from the main workflow because the only path from the communication-type decision to N14 does not select it independently; N13 and N14 share the same outgoing edge to End, and the leave branch is not distinguishable as an executed alternative action path.
prioritized_defects.evidence: Requirement R5 requires agents to join and leave a multicast group. The diagram contains both 'Join multicast group' (N13) and 'Leave multicast group' (N14), but the branch from N3 goes to N13 only, and N13/N14 both terminate via separate edges to the final node without a modeled decision that selects leave as an alternative executable path.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Model join and leave as separate alternatives under the multicast-group branch, with an explicit decision or branch that can route to N14, or otherwise connect N14 into the workflow so leave is an executable path.
Connect all diagram nodes to the main workflow.

final_recommendation: Address the control-flow reachability defect first, then resolve any remaining structural reachability issues.
